# Third-party art

These packs are not ours. They're used under their free licenses. Credit the authors on
the game's itch.io / release page. Each pack's own `read_me.txt` (where present) is the
canonical license.

| Folder | Pack | Author | License (summary) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tiny_swords/` | Tiny Swords (Update 010) | Pixel Frog | Free for commercial & non-commercial use. Do not redistribute/resell the raw assets. |
| `kings_and_pigs/` | Kings and Pigs | Pixel Frog | Free for commercial & non-commercial use. Do not redistribute/resell the raw assets. |
| `mystic_woods/` | Mystic Woods (free v2.2) | Game Endeavor | **Non-commercial only.** May modify. Do **not** redistribute/resell, even if modified. (see read_me.txt) |
| `cute_fantasy/` | Cute Fantasy (free) | see read_me.txt | **Non-commercial only.** May modify. Do **not** redistribute/resell, even if modified. (see read_me.txt) |

Notes:
- Mystic Woods + Cute Fantasy are **non-commercial** — if this game is ever sold, those two must be replaced.
- "No redistribution" means a **public** git repo technically conflicts with these terms; keep that in mind for where this is pushed.
